verdict: A hard week: leads dropped sharply and Google spend produced zero conversions.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 128 leads, all of them sourced from Meta — Google Ads generated zero conversions despite $1,495 in spend, making it the more pressing issue of the period. On top of that, Meta went dark on August 15–16 with no spend and no leads, which drove a 48% lead drop and pushed your cost per lead up 63% week-over-week to $22.23. Google campaign spend is being reviewed and restructured so that budget is tied to measurable results before more is committed; Meta is being monitored to confirm the two-day outage is resolved and volume is restored. Dedicated paid landing pages and a new creative batch are on track for August 31, both of which are expected to improve conversion rates on both channels heading into September.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, every one sourced from Meta
spent on Google Ads this period with zero conversions recorded
cost per lead this period, up 63% from the prior 7-day window

watch_item.issue: 135 leads entered the pipeline this period but no appointments were booked and none progressed to a win, pointing to a gap in intake or follow-up.
watch_item.fix: The lead intake and follow-up process is being audited as part of the CRM build, with all five identified gaps targeted for completion by August 31.
